verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions code-referencing, license attribution, or public-code matching. The permission prompts and PR review features are adjacent and earn no credit.
